args.summary: Release v2.3.1 of checkout-api deployed to production failed health checks in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an elevated error rate (~18%). Rollback executed to v2.3.0 across all production regions; service confirmed healthy with error rate back down to ~0.2%. Please investigate root cause in v2.3.1 (note: v2.3.1-rc in staging also unhealthy).
args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Investigated**: `/deployments` showed v2.3.1 (latest) was unhealthy in production, with v2.3.0 being the most recent previously healthy release. Live status confirmed v2.3.1 failing health checks in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back**: Restored checkout-api to v2.3.0 across all three production regions. Verified after rollback: service is healthy with error rate down to ~0.2%.
3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api detailing the v2.3.1 failures in all regions, the rollback to v2.3.0, and the healthy status post-rollback. On-call engineer has been paged.

Note for follow-up: v2.3.1-rc in staging was also unhealthy, suggesting the issue wasn't environment-specific — worth investigating the v2.3.1 code changes before attempting a redeploy.
